title: Utillian 723 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Utillian 723 is the newest addition to the Utillian family of portable vaporizers

It is an updated version of the popular Utillian 722. This update is exciting because it brings some improvements to an already great device. One notable improvement is the quick USB-C charging, which can fully charge the vaporizer in just around 90 minutes. Another great feature is the included wax canister, which allows you to use both dry herbs and concentrates with the Utillian 723. Using the vaporizer is simple, with just one button to switch between 4 temperature settings and a boost mode. This device is designed to be user-friendly while maintaining high quality. The convection heating technology ensures that each vaping session is just as enjoyable as the last. It also has the same powerful 2300 mAh battery as its predecessor, allowing for long-lasting sessions.

Key Features:
LED Interface
2300 mAh Battery
Haptic Feedback
7 Minutes Auto Shut-off Time
90 Minutes Charging Time
30 Seconds Heat-up Time

BONUS ITEMS: 4 PIECE PREMIUM GRINDER, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 BRUSH

Specs:
Battery 2300 mAh
Battery Life 60 Minutes
Heat time 30 Seconds
Heating Style Convection
Temperature 4 Pre-Set Temperature Settings + Boost Mode
Compatibility Dry Herbs, Wax
Compatible with Utillian Bubbler No
Compatible with Zeus Iceborn Yes
Warranty 2 Year with Manufacturer

Included in the Box:
– Utillian 723 Vaporizer
– Cleaning Brush
– USB-C Cable
– Wax Canister
– Packing Tool
-O-ring and screen set
